title: fix(app-shell): turning on Require MFA on an organization shows the grace period once
body:
Fixes #30565

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：组织记录勾选「强制 MFA」并保存成功后，提示里只出现服务端那句宽限期说明（天数取自部署设置）；控制台自己那句写死「7 天」的说明不再追加在下面。
- 为什么改：服务端自 PR #30529 起会在保存回答里带上真实宽限期的说明，控制台再加一句就重复两遍，Setup 改成 3 天时两句还互相矛盾（在 main `27b0bc79` 上用单元复现：提示两行，一行 3 天、一行 7 天）。
- 风险与回滚：只看回答里的 notice 是否以服务端那句开头（四种语言）；认不出时退回原样显示两句，不会两句都没有。没有 notice（旧服务端）照旧显示控制台那句。无数据迁移，回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/organizationMfaNotices.ts` 的 `SERVER_MFA_NOTICE_OPENINGS` 与 `isServerMfaNotice`；`AppContent.tsx` 的 `handleRecordFormSuccess` 里多传的 `answerNotice: claimed?.notice`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/organizationMfaNotices-30295.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.recordSaveOneToast-27999.test.tsx`，预期 26 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@object-ui/app-shell`, `organizationMfaSavedNotice`** (`console/organizationMfaNotices.ts`) takes one more optional input, `answerNotice`: the save answer's `notice` as the record form's claim took it. When that notice is the server's own MFA notice, the function returns `undefined`, so the console adds no `console.organizationMfa.nowRequired` line. Everything else it judged before (object, stored value, saved value) is unchanged.
- **`AppContent.tsx`, `handleRecordFormSuccess`** passes `answerNotice: claimed?.notice` to it. The join below (`claimed.notice` + the console line) is unchanged: with no console line it hands the claim's feedback through, so the toast carries the server's notice once.
- **The rule that tells the server's notice apart:** the notice contains the server copy's opening sentence in one of the four languages it is written in (`en`, `zh-CN`, `ja-JP`, `es-ES`; plugin-auth's `ORGANIZATION_MFA_REQUIRED_NOTICE_COPY`). The N-day and 0-day sentences open with the same one, so four constants cover all of them. A bare "a notice is there" check is not enough: the answer carries ONE notice, the last one a hook or a flow's `save_notice` node on the write set (`WRITE_ANSWER_NOTICE_DESCRIPTION` in the protocol, "when more than one call sets it, the LAST one wins"). The MFA guard sets its notice at `beforeInsert`/`beforeUpdate` priority 15, so any later hook replaces it. On that save a presence check would drop the only sentence that tells the administrator who will be blocked. The wrong direction for this rule is also the safe one: if the server's wording ever changes, the console shows both lines again, never neither.
- No i18n change: the console sentence still serves an answer that carries no server notice.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/30565-organization-mfa-notice-once.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

## Tests

A new top-level `describe` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/organizationMfaNotices-30295.test.tsx` (this module's existing harness):

- The answer carries the server notice: no console line. Five cases, the server's text verbatim: `en` 3 days, `en` 0 days, `zh-CN` 3 days, `ja-JP` 0 days, `es-ES` 3 days. Each fixture was checked byte-identical to `ORGANIZATION_MFA_REQUIRED_NOTICE_COPY[locale](days)` evaluated from the server source at this head.
- No notice on the answer: the console line, as before.
- Another hook's notice on the same save (`Sent to your manager for approval`): the console line too.

A new top-level `describe` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.recordSaveOneToast-27999.test.tsx` (the record-save toast harness, a real `AppContent` mount; the harness gains a `sys_organization` object, a `findOne` on its adapter stub answering the stored row with `require_mfa: false`, and `saveFrom` now checks the overlay edits the object the write names). An edit of organization `org_1` saves `require_mfa: true`:

- The answer's `notice` is the server's English 3-day notice (the 30295 fixture): ONE success toast, `Organization "Acme" updated`, whose description is the server notice alone; the stored row was read (`findOne('sys_organization', 'org_1')`).
- CONTROL: no notice on the answer: the description is the console line (`console.organizationMfa.nowRequired` in `en`, which names 7 days).
- CONTROL: another hook's notice on the answer: the description is that notice, then the console line.

## Acceptance notes

- **The two copies, compared.** The console line says: members without an authenticator app must enroll; they are blocked from data once the grace period ends; "7 days unless changed in Setup → Authentication"; counted from first use after the change; members who already use one are not affected. The server notice says all of that, with the real number of days and where it is set. Nothing the console line says is lost.
- **Languages.** The server copy is written in four languages, and other caller locales get the English one (`copyLocaleFor`). The console ships ten locales. A console in `de`, `fr`, `ko`, `pt`, `ru` or `ar` used to show the English server notice followed by its own localized line. It now shows the English server notice only. Adding those six languages to the server copy belongs to the server lane (out of scope here).
- **Mount-level pin.** The decision is pinned on the function, and the one wiring line in `AppContent.tsx` (`answerNotice: claimed?.notice`) is pinned on a mounted `AppContent` in the shared record-save toast harness (see Tests). Deleting that line reds the server-notice case (ablation 3).
- The four opening sentences are a second copy of server text in the console, and no gate checks the two against each other. The test fixtures are the server's text at this head. A protocol-level code on the answer's notice would remove the copy, but that is a contract change, out of scope.
